import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static class Modular {
        static int mod;
        int value;

        Modular(int x) {
            value = normalize(x);
        }

        static int normalize(long x) {
            int v = (int)(x % mod);
            if (v < 0) v += mod;
            return v;
        }

        Modular add(Modular other) {
            int sum = value + other.value;
            if (sum >= mod) sum -= mod;
            return new Modular(sum);
        }

        Modular subtract(Modular other) {
            int diff = value - other.value;
            if (diff < 0) diff += mod;
            return new Modular(diff);
        }

        Modular multiply(Modular other) {
            long prod = (long)value * other.value;
            return new Modular(normalize(prod));
        }

        Modular divide(Modular other) {
            return multiply(new Modular(inverse(other.value, mod)));
        }

        Modular negate() {
            return new Modular(-value);
        }

        static int inverse(int a, int m) {
            int u = 0, v = 1;
            int originalM = m;
            while (a != 0) {
                int t = m / a;
                m -= t * a;
                int temp = a; a = m; m = temp;
                u -= t * v;
                temp = u; u = v; v = temp;
            }
            // m should be 1 (coprime)
            if (m != 1) throw new ArithmeticException("Inverse does not exist");
            return normalize(u);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Integer.toString(value);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int md = sc.nextInt();
        Modular.mod = md;

        // Precompute factorials up to m
        Modular[] fact = new Modular[m + 1];
        Modular[] invFact = new Modular[m + 1];
        fact[0] = new Modular(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1].multiply(new Modular(i));
        }
        invFact[m] = new Modular(1).divide(fact[m]);
        for (int i = m - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFact[i] = invFact[i + 1].multiply(new Modular(i + 1));
        }

        // Binomial coefficient function
        java.util.function.BiFunction<Integer, Integer, Modular> C = (x, y) -> {
            if (y < 0 || y > x) return new Modular(0);
            return fact[x].multiply(invFact[y]).multiply(invFact[x - y]);
        };

        Modular inv2 = new Modular(2).divide(new Modular(2)); // Actually we need inverse of 2
        inv2 = new Modular(1).divide(new Modular(2)); // Better: 1/2 mod md

        Modular[] ptrWays = new Modular[m + 1];
        Modular[] ptrDp = new Modular[m + 1];
        ptrWays[0] = new Modular(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            ptrWays[i] = new Modular(0);
            ptrDp[i] = new Modular(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Modular comb = C.apply(l + r, l);
                Modular term = ptrWays[l].multiply(ptrWays[r]).multiply(comb).multiply(new Modular(l + r + 2));
                ptrWays[i] = ptrWays[i].add(term);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Modular comb = C.apply(l + r, l);
                // add = (l*(l+1) + r*(r+1)) / 2
                long sum = (long)l * (l + 1) + (long)r * (r + 1);
                Modular add = new Modular((int)(sum % md)).multiply(inv2);
                Modular term1 = ptrWays[l].multiply(ptrWays[r]).multiply(comb).multiply(add);
                ptrDp[i] = ptrDp[i].add(term1);
                Modular term2 = (ptrDp[l].multiply(ptrWays[r]).add(ptrDp[r].multiply(ptrWays[l]))).multiply(C.apply(l + r, r)).multiply(new Modular(l + r + 2));
                ptrDp[i] = ptrDp[i].add(term2);
            }
        }

        Modular[][] ways = new Modular[n + 1][m + 1];
        Modular[][] dp = new Modular[n + 1][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= m; s++) {
                ways[i][s] = new Modular(0);
                dp[i][s] = new Modular(0);
            }
        }
        ways[0][0] = new Modular(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= Math.min(m, i); s++) {
                if (s == i) {
                    dp[i][s] = ptrDp[s];
                    ways[i][s] = ptrWays[s];
                    continue;
                }
                for (int d = 1; d <= s + 1; d++) {
                    Modular ft = dp[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    Modular way = ways[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                    int add = d - 1;
                    Modular comb = C.apply(s, add);
                    ways[i][s] = ways[i][s].add(way.multiply(ptrWays[add]).multiply(comb));
                    dp[i][s] = dp[i][s].add(way.multiply(ptrDp[add]).add(ptrWays[add].multiply(ft)).multiply(comb));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp[n][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
